## Mandatory non-degradation rules

1. Never describe termination of the separate RPL 3319/2025 roll as a merits dismissal, abandonment, withdrawal or loss by Aweswell without new signed source evidence establishing that proposition.
2. Never describe LPB as merely an informal supporter or spectator. LPB independently challenged the refusal through RPL 3304/2025.
3. Never reduce the matter to “Aweswell's failed separation demand.”
4. Always retain the relationship: original 23-Apr-2025 application → first-instance refusal/reconsideration → LPB appeal 3304 → Aweswell appeal 3319 → accumulation → 3304 live consolidated vehicle.
5. Preserve the distinction between pleaded relief/allegations, judicial findings, appellate contentions, reconstruction/inference and unresolved responsibility.
6. Do not infer a Judge, LAJ, Fiscal, panel member or office-holder from institutional proximity. Each person edge requires a source-specific act/capacity basis or an explicit identity gap.
7. Accumulation is a procedural relationship, not proof that both appeals have identical grounds or that either succeeds on the merits.
